bugs.error_message: Refresh could issue a replacement after concurrent revocation or misclassify a revoked token as a refresh race.
bugs.root_cause: Account state was read before the transaction and token rows were changed without a shared account lock order.
bugs.fix: Serialize credential mutations on the PostgreSQL user row and re-read token state after locking.

bugs.error_message: Any nonempty CSRF header passed cookie refresh and logout validation.
bugs.root_cause: The header was checked for presence but never compared with a session-side value.
bugs.fix: Issue a random readable CSRF cookie, compare it to the header, and validate exact allowed origins.

bugs.error_message: Generated initial migration declared each PostgreSQL enum twice, including a nonexistent schema.
bugs.root_cause: HasPostgresEnum was called with the enum name as the schema argument while MapEnum already registered the enum.
bugs.fix: Remove duplicate explicit enum registrations and regenerate the new initial migration.

bugs.error_message: Login and refresh returned the Host account ID twice, once as accountId and once as tenantId; JWTs also emitted tenantId.
bugs.root_cause: Stale Auth requirements were applied despite the current model using HostAccountId and no separate tenant ID.
bugs.fix: Remove tenantId from Auth responses, JWT generation and validation, and align affected requirements with HostAccountId.

bugs.error_message: Realtime group placeholder hostAccountId appeared to imply a separate account table.
bugs.root_cause: The docs used the schema field name without explaining that it references users.id.
bugs.fix: Clarify that hostAccountId is the Host users.id stored in games.host_account_id.

bugs.error_message: Quiz mutation could pass the active-game check and commit after game creation.
bugs.root_cause: Quiz mutations checked active games outside a transaction and did not share the Host row lock used by game creation.
bugs.fix: Wrap quiz mutations in ReadCommitted transactions and hold the Host row lock through validation and commit; game creation uses the same lock before copying the snapshot.

bugs.error_message: Creating a game from an owned empty quiz returned 404 Quiz.QuestionNotFound.
bugs.root_cause: The old eligibility gate made the existing empty-quiz branch rarely reachable, and it reused the missing-question error.
bugs.fix: Return 400 Validation.Failed for an owned quiz with zero questions and document the boundary.

bugs.error_message: Concurrent answers could overwrite accepted counts and commit before equality auto-close.
bugs.root_cause: Answer, host end, and participant removal did not share a game-row lock; auto-close ran in a later transaction.
bugs.fix: Serialize under ordered Host/Game locks and commit answer, score, count, and auto-close together; do the same for removal.

bugs.error_message: Changing the submitted question ID or sending malformed hub choices bypassed answer attempt limits.
bugs.root_cause: Rate keys trusted client question IDs, malformed hub calls returned before counting, and the socket counter used a fixed TTL window.
bugs.fix: Derive the active question from the database, count malformed hub attempts, and use a bounded Redis rolling sorted-set window.

bugs.error_message: Active-question reconnect payload revealed score points before question results.
bugs.root_cause: Catch-up used Participant.TotalScore, which was updated at answer commit.
bugs.fix: Project the visible score from only prior-question submissions and fail closed if the active snapshot is absent.

bugs.error_message: A single FOR UPDATE game lock serialized all participant answer transactions and duplicate insert races could surface as errors.
bugs.root_cause: The ingestion path locked the game exclusively before all scoring work and retried only deadlocks, not the answer uniqueness collision.
bugs.fix: Use compatible FOR SHARE game locks, atomically update the accepted count at the end of the transaction, and retry the named unique collision to return the committed answer.

bugs.error_message: Removing a participant during the leaderboard left gaps in survivor ranks and stale visible standings.
bugs.root_cause: Ranks were materialized only when entering LEADERBOARD or FINISHED, not after a participant tombstone while LEADERBOARD remained active.
bugs.fix: Flush the tombstone, re-materialize survivor ranks in the removal transaction, and publish updated standings after commit.

bugs.error_message: Post-commit Redis failures could make committed player join/removal or reconnect appear to fail.
bugs.root_cause: Presence count and eviction publication were awaited after PostgreSQL commit without isolating their failures from command results.
bugs.fix: Log post-commit notification and eviction errors while returning committed results; mark bound sockets authenticated before optional notifications.

bugs.error_message: ParticipantRemoved lacked the required committed stateVersion and socket removal frames could wait serially.
bugs.root_cause: The Redis kick message had no stateVersion and the subscriber sent each client frame in a sequential loop.
bugs.fix: Carry the committed version through the kick message and send a bounded group frame before aborting local sockets.

bugs.error_message: A 64 KB SignalR pipe threshold alone did not disconnect a stalled reader.
bugs.root_cause: TransportMaxBufferSize pauses writers at the threshold but does not enforce a timely close.
bugs.fix: Set TransportSendTimeout to two seconds and bound personal fan-out to 32 concurrent sends per game.

bugs.error_message: A replica could accept sockets before the player eviction Redis subscription completed.
bugs.root_cause: BackgroundService.StartAsync returned while ExecuteAsync awaited SubscribeAsync.
bugs.fix: Gate hosted-service startup on a subscription-ready completion source.

bugs.error_message: Sequential Redis lease renewal could outlast the 45-second lease at 25,000 sockets.
bugs.root_cause: RenewAllAsync awaited four Redis commands for each connection before starting the next one.
bugs.fix: Renew up to 128 independent connection leases concurrently while retaining each connection gate and bounded task memory.

bugs.error_message: A missed Redis Pub/Sub eviction could leave a removed or stale-generation player socket in a SignalR group.
bugs.root_cause: The player heartbeat only renewed Redis leases and never rechecked authoritative PostgreSQL status or generation.
bugs.fix: Every 10 seconds, batch committed local sockets into indexed PostgreSQL participant/Host checks and abort invalid bindings; skip provisional pre-commit joins to avoid false eviction.

bugs.error_message: A removed participant received Game.InvalidSessionToken rather than Game.ParticipantRemoved on reconnect.
bugs.root_cause: The token revocation check returned before the participant tombstone was inspected; removal revokes the token in the same transaction.
bugs.fix: Inspect the participant under the ordered game and participant locks before returning the revocation error.

bugs.error_message: Host suspension and expiry could change while a reconnect was waiting to bind its socket.
bugs.root_cause: Host status was read without a row lock after the game lock, and token expiry was sampled before transaction lock waits.
bugs.fix: Acquire a compatible Host row lock before the game lock and evaluate expiry against PostgreSQL time after locking the participant.

bugs.error_message: Catch-up could report an empty question state or reject a retry on the same live socket after a lost response.
bugs.root_cause: Missing snapshots had success fallbacks, rank fallback used a query inconsistent with materialized ranks, and reconnect rejected every bound socket.
bugs.fix: Fail on missing phase data, use persisted ranks, and allow same-participant socket retries with a new generation.

bugs.error_message: ValidationBehavior shares a single ValidationContext across concurrent validator executions, resulting in accumulated failure counts.
bugs.root_cause: A single ValidationContext instance was passed to Task.WhenAll across registered validators, causing each validator to append to the shared context failure list.
bugs.fix: Documented the shared context accumulation behavior and updated unit tests to assert failure presence and distinct error coverage.

bugs.error_message: Source-defined duplicate traceId extension is expected when ApiController.Problem executes with an active Activity and the ASP.NET Core 10.0.12 default MVC factory; runtime reproduction pending.
bugs.root_cause: DefaultProblemDetailsFactory inserts traceId before ControllerBase.Problem adds caller extensions with Dictionary.Add; ApiController also supplies traceId when Activity.Current is nonnull.
bugs.fix: Not changed in this planning task. API unit plan Phase 1 requires a real-factory regression assertion and reporting the failure; a production fix requires separate authorization.

bugs.error_message: Source-defined default ProblemDetails writer overwrites the API supplied 32-character traceId with the full W3C Activity.Id; final response reproduction pending.
bugs.root_cause: Default AddProblemDetails registration has no customization; the ASP.NET Core 10.0.12 writer assigns Activity.Current.Id to the traceId extension after exception/JWT components construct their response.
bugs.fix: Not changed in this planning task. Documented the OPS-OBS-004 mismatch and required final-response integration evidence in the API unit plan.

bugs.error_message: Source/spec gap: quiz mutation inputs have no expected revision and EF Quiz.Revision is not a concurrency token; documented stale-edit conflict is not implemented.
bugs.root_cause: Host-row locking serializes writes but cannot reject a stale client revision that the command never supplies; the mapping only defines a required revision field/default.
bugs.fix: No production fix made. Documented QUIZ-RISK-002, QUIZ-TEST-008 and RACE-QZ-01 gap in the Application integration plan; future contract/production changes require separate scope.

bugs.error_message: Plan source-name review found implicit administration request names; final handoff review also encountered a concurrently updated OpenWolf status entry.
bugs.root_cause: The initial administration family wildcard did not spell out each input contract; an adjacent status section changed while another agent finished API unit work.
bugs.fix: Added exact administration requests/inputs, concrete Advance race scenarios and lifecycle/configuration details; used stable OpenWolf heading patches to preserve the other agent's records. Final document validation passes.

bugs.error_message: Initial plan deferred a provider-required delivery helper and described a directory sentinel as an unlink exception; an implicit-transaction reader gate also needed a precise boundary.
bugs.root_cause: Phase ordering and filesystem/reader lifetime assumptions needed an explicit self-review against current source.
bugs.fix: Moved the recording transport helper into Phase 1, distinguished directory safety from actual unlink failure, specified consumed-reader commit visibility, and made Redis cancellation deterministic in a dedicated paused server. No production behavior was changed.

bugs.error_message: Plan self-review found an inaccessible Api CurrentUser registration in migration preparation, incomplete ownership on failed host startup, and implicit close-frame observation.
bugs.root_cause: Helper visibility and actual factory/transport lifetimes needed a source-based review before handoff.
bugs.fix: Specified an anonymous migration-only caller while retaining real HTTP CurrentUser; retained partially started host ownership for disposal; named actual WebSocket close-frame observation and lifecycle gates. No production code changed.
